# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Governance or policy update
- [ ] Maintenance
- [ ] Other

## Security Impact

Does this change introduce, modify, or disclose security-sensitive information?

- [ ] No
- [ ] Yes

If yes, explain the impact and confirm that it does not include live credentials, private keys, secrets, personal data, unsafe exploit details, or nonpublic third-party vulnerability information.

## Responsible Use Review

Confirm the following:

- [ ] This contribution is intended for defensive, educational, research, or public-interest use.
- [ ] This contribution does not enable unauthorized access or harmful activity.
- [ ] This contribution does not include live secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, or unnecessary personal data.
- [ ] This contribution follows `SECURITY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.

## Testing

Describe how this was tested, if applicable.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation was updated, if needed.
- [ ] No documentation update is needed.

## Related Issues

Link related issues, discussions, or pull requests.
